summary: Upstox drops the socket: the feed authorizes again, connects to the new signed address and subscribes again; the first packet after it shows only what it carries.

deviations.reason: The web keeps Upstox's merged snapshot across a reconnect (_on_connect replays the subscriptions only), so its first packet after an outage publishes the old session's fields as current; the desktop starts the merge afresh (UpstoxFeed::on_connected), as CLAUDE.md requires (a cached market field belongs to the session that sent it) and the audit's regression matrix asks (reconnect with the first packet partial). Lead ruling 2026-11-09.
